svg.title: 4. Onboarding automation and per-tenant metering
svg.text: Onboarding is one workflow with two paths, and metering joins usage events with the AWS bill to give cost per tenant
Basic / Pro: pool path, about 40 seconds
Enterprise: silo path, about 90 minutes, no human steps
registry: status = ACTIVE; billing, metering and
dashboards subscribe to the same event
Offboarding is the same machine in reverse: suspend, export data for the customer,
wait the contractual retention period, then delete data, keys and (silo) close the account.
Fix: price Basic on documents processed,
not on seats, and cap bulk imports.
